text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the Takarazuka Kinen, Winning
Ticket and I
spend some time thinking
about what Biwa
Hayahide said.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What is it about me now that's so
different
compared to when I ran the
Derby?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, I remember that! It got me all
scared!
choice_data_list: 確かダービー前は怖い夢を見て……
choice_data_list_en: If I recall, you had a nightmare before the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But that makes sense, right? It was my big dream, to go to the Derby. I really couldn't stand the thought of losing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She couldn't stand... losing?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It seems like losing to me in that final
struggle has
got her rather worked up.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wouldn't scrimmages be more
useful than
training on her own though?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the one we had just now was
really great!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh? Was it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The last sprint between you and
Taishin
was such a tough fight!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone said it was a really intense
race!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Did you think so too?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Even though you lost?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I didn't notice since Ticket is
always so
earnest, but it's true that
something important
has changed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's going on? What feeling?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
choice_data_list: 絶対に負けたくないって気持ちだ！
絶対に負けたくないって気持ち！
choice_data_list_en: It's that determination to never lose!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I couldn't stand the
thought of it...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Maybe I'm seeing things wrong.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I thought all I wanted was more amazing
races
like the Derby—running against my
rivals, the
audience getting super into
it...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I figured that would be enough to satisfy
me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So maybe I lost sight of the feeling I had back then—that I absolutely didn't wanna lose, that I had to win.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh... Yeah, you're right.
choice_data_list: でもその気持ちこそが大切なんだ
choice_data_list_en: But that feeling is what really matters.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: If "having an awesome race" is all that I try for, it's never really gonna be an awesome race.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I've gotta go for broke! Aim to win no matter what! 'Cause when everyone competes with everything they've got, that's when you get a race as fiery as the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin and Hayahide put all their heart
into
winning, and that's why they keep
improving.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But I wasn't serious about getting first
place... so I
wasn't a real rival to them at
all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I wanna win! I gotta beat Taishin
and
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No... not just them. I wanna beat
everyone! I can't
lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll win every time and show the audience
what a
real awesome race looks like!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I realize now...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's the dream I've been chasing all along!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her resolute declaration moves my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Much like the very first time she told me
about
the Derby and her dream.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The biggest?
choice_data_list: なら、最高の舞台を目指そう！
choice_data_list_en: Then let's aim for the grandest stage of all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa, the Arima Kinen! So many
famous
showdowns happened there!
choice_data_list: 年末のグランプリ『有馬記念』だ！
年末のグランプリ『有馬記念』だよ！
choice_data_list_en: The year-end Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen!
It's the year-end Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll become a legend once I win
it! So it's
time to train!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But before that, I need to do one last
important
thing. Hold on a sec!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hurry after Winning Ticket as she
dashes off.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin! Hayahide! Race against me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pass.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No passing! The loser buys everyone
juice!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket... If you simply want to have fun
at
practice, now is not—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No holding back! This is gonna be a
serious
showdown between the three of
us!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Pleeease! I'm begging you—I really gotta
tell you
both something!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
History shows that she will not be
denied. You
know that as well as I do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Then it's on! Okay, get readyyy, GO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though they run in cheerful weather,
under a
pleasant, blue sky...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final hundred meters of the sudden
race
spark a serious battle.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Both of them are really in the zone!
They're so
fast!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But don't count me out! I'm not gonna
lose this
tiiime!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket! Huff... Failure is not an option for me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, I'm gonna leave both of you behind!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket is the first to sprint
forward, but
the others quickly kick into
high gear and give
chase.

text_block_list.name: BNW
text_block_list.text: HAAAAHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each unleashing every last ounce of their
stamina,
the three racers bound across
the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's... my... WIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racers drop down on their knees,
too
exhausted to say anything for a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys... I know I haven't been
good
enough to be your rival.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Especially lately, but that's 'cause I
forgot about
the most important thing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, well...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's why today I've gotta tell you
exactly how I
really feel!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's hear it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide! You always know how to
analyze the
whole race ahead! You're
calm, but also
passionate, and I love
that about you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't wanna lose against
you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I understand.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And Taishin! Your final sprints are so
great it's
crazy! You're awesome, and a
little scary, and I
love that about you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I don't wanna lose against
you
either!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I know.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Both of you are my all-time favorites—my most respected rivals! And I really wanna beat you more than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm entering the Arima Kinen, so will you
please
race me there?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want to have a real battle against you
two, as
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the sight of Winning Ticket's earnest

expression, a fond smile widens across
Biwa
Hayahide's face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Rivals, hm? I know that look in your eyes
well
enough.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
All right. I'll enter the Arima Kinen. It's a
promise.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aww, H-Hayahideee!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I... have things I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So I don't have time to be playing
around with
you guys.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But a race against the two of you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose it's worth making time
for.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Th-then does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But if you put on a weak-sauce
performance at
the Arima Kinen, I'll
literally kick your butt.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: TAISHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket wraps her two friends in
a big hug.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I-idiot, you're crushing me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAH! Let's do everything we can to
make
the Arima Kinen the greatest ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Winning Ticket's emotion-filled cry
echoes
across the track, it's clear that
the members of
BNW are rivals once
more.
